name: C12 AI Smart Tracking Selfie Stick Tripod
description:
AI Auto Tracking Technology – Smart face/object tracking keeps you in focus at all times
2-in-1 Design – Functions as both a selfie stick and a stable quadrupod tripod
Extendable up to 1.0 Meter – Capture wider angles and better perspectives
Bluetooth Remote Control – Take photos and videos wirelessly with ease
Strong & Stable Build – Designed for balance and durability during use
Foldable & Portable – Compact design makes it easy to carry anywhere
Universal Compatibility – Works with most iOS & Android smartphones
